> 弟兄们看过来（第1页）
真是抱歉，我知道前面几章有些压抑。
我想表达的其实只有一点，那就是在那个时代，正是这无数个不知名姓，如飞蛾扑火般的人，前仆后继的牺牲，这才换来了我们的今天。
在那个时代，那些人可没有遇到主角。
但细想一下，如果主角现在还在孤岛上，那么这些事就不会发生了吗？一样会发生！
他们一样会干，一样会飞蛾扑火，那你能说他们的牺牲没有意义吗？
我只是简单表达了一下，没想到会引起这么强烈的反应，这是我的错，后面基本没有这种剧情了。
就是因为前面老是有人在说，说又是一本打怪升级的套路文，又是没有任何的深度，真是让人失望啊之类。
我就想着，要不咱也加点有深度的。
至于读者说为什么主角不找个地方躲起来，三年五载后出来后就天下无敌了？
外面局势天天都在变化，别说三年五载，主角现在就闭关三天，你们就受不了了，还谈什么三年五载？
准确的说，主角从丹劲中期到丹劲后期，就闭关两天，这一点书上写的异常明确。
只不过是多条线交替进行，让你感觉事情很多，但其实都是这两天发生的。

>Brothers, look over (page 1)
I'm so sorry, I know the first few chapters were a bit depressing.
In fact, there is only one thing I want to express, and that is that in that era, it was the sacrifices of countless unknown people, like moths to the flame, that brought us where we are today.
In that era, those people did not meet the protagonist.
But think about it carefully, if the protagonist is still on the island now, wouldn't these things happen? The same will happen!
They are just as good at what they do, and they are just as capable of turning moths into flames, so can you say that their sacrifices are meaningless?
I just expressed it briefly. I didn't expect it would cause such a strong reaction. It's my fault. There will be basically no such plot in the future.
It’s just because people are always saying that it’s another routine book about killing monsters and upgrading, and it doesn’t have any depth, which is really disappointing.
I just thought, how about we add something more in-depth.
As for the readers’ question, why doesn’t the protagonist find a place to hide and become invincible when he comes out after three to five years?
The situation outside is changing every day. Let alone three years and five years. If the protagonist is in seclusion for three days now, you won't be able to bear it. Why talk about three years or five years?
To be precise, the protagonist goes into seclusion for two days from the middle stage of Dan Jin to the late stage of Dan Jin. This is very clear in the book.
It's just multiple lines running alternately, making you feel like there are a lot of things going on, but in fact they all happened in these two days.
